[d0749] config | acktracker.max_retries | version 4.x
# `acktracker.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `20` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_retries = 20
```

---

[d0637] config | acktracker.max_connections | version 4.x
# `acktracker.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `128` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | connections |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.max_connections` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_connections = 128
```
